units.translation: where Wecklein conjectured τοιαϊσδέ με [with such as these ... me], because Aeschylus does not seem to have used the form τοῖος [such] except when the meter required it.
where τοίων [of such] is corrupt, the penultimate letter of which was made from o in M.
where the first syllable is shortened as in Ag. 1400 ἥτις τοιόνδ᾽ ἐπ᾽ ἀνδρὶ κομπάζεις λόγον [you who boast such a word over a man].
